# PyAutoLens Assistant

> The front door of the PyAutoLens Assistant — an AI assistant for doing strong-lens science
> with PyAutoLens (agent instructions, task skills and a reference wiki in one repository that
> you drive in natural language from inside an AI coding agent). It routes by intent: set up,
> see what the assistant can do, read the reference, or jump to runnable examples.

## How to use it

The assistant is supported **only inside an AI coding agent** that can read this repository and
execute Python: **Claude Code** or **Codex** (recommended and tested), or **OpenCode** as an
experimental alternative. Clone the repository and open the agent inside it — `AGENTS.md`
(via `CLAUDE.md` for Claude Code) loads automatically and nothing else is needed:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/PyAutoLabs/autolens_assistant.git
cd autolens_assistant
claude        # or: codex / opencode
```

Setup pages: [`docs/setup/claude_code.md`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PyAutoLabs/autolens_assistant/main/docs/setup/claude_code.md)
· [`docs/setup/codex_cli.md`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PyAutoLabs/autolens_assistant/main/docs/setup/codex_cli.md)
· [`docs/setup/opencode_cli.md`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PyAutoLabs/autolens_assistant/main/docs/setup/opencode_cli.md).
Desktop and IDE versions of these agents are fine when they provide the same repository and
execution access. Browser chats with a GitHub connector, the custom GPT and pasted bundles are
**no longer supported** (retired 2026-09-10; see
[`docs/archive/`](https://github.com/PyAutoLabs/autolens_assistant/tree/main/docs/archive)).

Agentic does not mean autonomous: you can ask questions, plan an analysis or learn in
**Teacher Mode** without running anything — say so in your prompt.

## If you are an agent reading this file

Read order: [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PyAutoLabs/autolens_assistant/main/AGENTS.md)
(safety rules, modes, conventions) →
[skills/README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PyAutoLabs/autolens_assistant/main/skills/README.md)
→ the relevant skill → [wiki/](https://github.com/PyAutoLabs/autolens_assistant/tree/main/wiki).

**⚠️ API currency — read before writing any PyAutoLens code.** Older PyAutoLens releases are
heavily represented in model training data and their API is **out of date**. Do **not** write
PyAutoLens from memory — mirror the exact calls shown in the relevant
[`skills/`](https://github.com/PyAutoLabs/autolens_assistant/tree/main/skills) file and verify
symbols against the installed library (`dir()`, or
`python autoassistant/audit_skill_apis.py --code "<snippet>"` on a harness without the
PreToolUse code gate). The single most common stale error: **plotting is functional now.** Use
`aplt.subplot_fit_imaging(fit=fit, output_path=..., output_filename=..., output_format="png")`
and `aplt.subplot_imaging_dataset(dataset=..., ...)`. The old object-oriented plotters —
`aplt.FitImagingPlotter`, `aplt.ImagingPlotter`, `aplt.TracerPlotter`, `aplt.MatPlot2D`,
`aplt.Output` — have been **removed**; never emit them.

**Real data → inspect before fitting.** Plot the dataset and settle contaminants and the mask
extent with the user before composing any fit; if you cannot execute code in this session, ask
the user to do it and report back — the gate is never waived.

## Agent instructions (canonical)

- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PyAutoLabs/autolens_assistant/main/AGENTS.md): safety rules, modes, and repository conventions — the source of truth.

## What it can do

- [skills/README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PyAutoLabs/autolens_assistant/main/skills/README.md): one-line index of every task skill.

## Reference

- [wiki/core/index.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PyAutoLabs/autolens_assistant/main/wiki/core/index.md): curated PyAuto* reference — stack, lensing concepts, API catalogues, operations.
- [wiki/literature/index.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PyAutoLabs/autolens_assistant/main/wiki/literature/index.md): strong-lensing science wiki — concepts, named entities (surveys, lenses), bibliography. **Large — read single pages, never the whole tree.**

## Runnable examples & tutorials (elsewhere)

- [autolens_workspace navigator](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PyAutoLabs/autolens_workspace/main/llms.txt): task router for end-to-end example scripts and notebooks.
- [HowToLens](https://github.com/PyAutoLabs/HowToLens): from-first-principles strong-lensing lecture series.
